question: What capacity retention did the 0.5 Ah NFA/graphite pouch cells show, and after how many cycles?
rendered:
Document title: "Next-Generation Cobalt-Free Cathodes – A Prospective Solution to the Battery Industry's Cobalt Problem"

Page 8: 
- Our team successfully demonstrated cobalt-free LIB pouch cells containing NFA cathodes paired against graphite anodes.
- The assembled pouch cells (0.5 Ah) were subjected to charge/discharge cycling at C/3 and exhibited a reasonable capacity retention of 72% even after 200 such cycles, as shown in Figure 6e.
